name: IMARTIAN_ST_IDLE
meaning: SetState 0: random STAND0/STAND1/STAND3/STAND4 (voice 0xdf); Update: chases the shrunk Ralph (1) or flees (2) (inferred)

name: IMARTIAN_ST_FLEE
meaning: SetState 2: anim RUN, heading turned half round. Update: runs straight away from Ralph (heading from Ralph to the martian) at 600 units/s scaled, turning off walls and the edge of the run boxes; back to 0 once Ralph is more than 600 units away, to 5 near either end of the TRAJECTORY (MARTIENBEHAVIOR 3), to 1 when Ralph is shrunk. Entered from 0 when Ralph comes within 400 units (MARTIENBEHAVIOR 1, or 3 with Ralph inside its current box), from 1 or 7 when Ralph is no longer shrunk, and from 5 at a trajectory end inside the first or second box of its BOX..BOX5 list (verified)

name: IMARTIAN_ST_PATROL
meaning: SetState 5: anim RUN; Update: trajectory patrol (inferred)

name: IMARTIAN_ST_HIT
meaning: SetState 8: anim HIT2A, not collidable; Update: -> 10 or 9 (inferred)

name: IMARTIAN_ST_HIT_LAND
meaning: SetState 9: anim HIT at the Wolf position (inferred)

name: IMARTIAN_ST_HIT_HOLD
meaning: SetState 10: anim HIT2B, holds the Wolf (MSG_KILL arg 0xd) (inferred)

name: IMARTIAN_ST_HIDDEN_CHECKPOINT
meaning: SetState 14: always updated, hidden, not collidable; Update: -> 4 outside the checkpoint box (inferred)
